reply_text:
I posted the draft here in #strategic-random as a reply to you, so you can edit it before sending it to Mateo's team:

- First report: 10:42 AM on Aug 3. Gate kiosks were offline and both inbound lanes showed a white screen.
- Kiosk 1 came back: 11:03 AM (trailer 8836 checked in).
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.

I kept it to operational facts from #inc-vtg-hartford. Open items are the status-page access issue (INC-4821) and the incident staying open for another arrival cycle. I did not send anything to Mateo or by email.
